Tamoxifen 20 mg daily has been shown to be ef- fective in patients with both cyclic and non-cyclic mastalgia,1 and improvement has also been reported at a lower dose of 10 mg daily.2 However, there is concern about the use of tamoxifen in otherwise healthy premenopausal women,3-5 particularly since many patients relapse on withdrawal,2 and it has been recommended6,7 that tamoxifen be reserved for pa- tients who fail to respond to other drugs (see p.2092).
